# DevPulse

> DevPulse (Devpulse Limited) is a UK studio that builds iOS and Android apps for clients and publishes its own apps and games. This file summarises the site for AI agents and language models.

## Apps

- [AuthSome](https://devpulse.co.uk/authsome/): A free two factor authenticator app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Details below.
- [Kids Paint](https://devpulse.co.uk/kidspaint/): A drawing and colouring app for kids on iPhone, iPad and Android.
- [TwinFin](https://devpulse.co.uk/twinfin/): A one thumb arcade game for iPhone with a new level every day.
- [Coconut Rocket](https://devpulse.co.uk/coconut-rocket/): An endless arcade climber for iPhone.
- [All apps](https://devpulse.co.uk/apps/): Every DevPulse app, including the free Mac utilities FannyBoost and ScreenBoost.

## AuthSome

AuthSome is a free authenticator app. It makes the time based 2FA codes (one time codes, TOTP) that websites and apps ask for during two factor authentication, and keeps personal and work codes apart.

- Price: free. No ads, no subscription, no purchases and no account to create.
- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 26 or later), iPad (iPadOS 26 or later) and Mac (macOS 26 or later). One app for all three. There is no Android or Apple Watch version.
- Status: coming soon to the App Store. It is not available to download yet.
- Profiles: each Profile, such as Personal or Work, holds its own Accounts, and only one Profile shows at a time. Profiles can be sorted into Folders.
- AutoFill: AuthSome suggests the 2FA code above the keyboard when a sign in page asks for one. The user confirms with Face ID.
- Backup and sync: Accounts sync through the user's own private iCloud. Secrets, recovery codes and everything the user types are end to end encrypted. Accounts can also be exported to a file protected with a password.
- Import: from Google Authenticator, 2FAS, Aegis, setup links (otpauth) and AuthSome backups.
- Security: the app locks with Face ID, Touch ID or the device passcode. Secrets are kept in the device Keychain.
- Privacy: AuthSome collects nothing. It has no servers of its own, no tracking and no code from other companies.
- Languages: 44.
- Maker: DevPulse, United Kingdom. Contact: support@devpulse.co.uk

Pages:

- [AuthSome home](https://devpulse.co.uk/authsome/): what the app is and what it does.
- [Privacy policy](https://devpulse.co.uk/authsome/privacy/): what stays on the device, what goes to iCloud, and what is not collected.
- [Support](https://devpulse.co.uk/authsome/support/): how to add Accounts, set up AutoFill, import from another app, back up and move to a new device.

The service names and logos shown on the AuthSome page are examples. AuthSome is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any of them.
